decks.notes: The deck focuses on generating mana quickly with cards like Dark Ritual and Lion's Eye Diamond, while also utilizing Wishclaw Talisman to search for key combo pieces. By using cards like Infernal Tutor and Burning Wish, players can search for win conditions like Tendrils of Agony to finish the game. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Duress and Cabal Therapy to disrupt opponents' game plans. The goal is to assemble the necessary cards to storm off and win the game in one explosive turn.

This deck focuses on using creatures with infect, such as Blighted Agent and Glistener Elf, to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to 10 or less. It utilizes cards like Berserk, Invigorate, and Scale Up to pump up the power of its infect creatures and deal large amounts of damage in a single attack. The deck also includes a suite of disruption spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect its creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It utilizes powerful cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for its combo pieces and maintain card advantage.

The deck focuses on assembling the Cephalid Breakfast combo to win the game quickly. It uses cards like Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill the library, triggering Narcomoeba and Thassa's Oracle to win the game. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Will and Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo. Urza's Saga provides additional value by tutoring for key pieces. The deck aims to efficiently combo off while disrupting the opponent's game plan, making it a powerful and strategic choice in Legacy competitive play.

This deck focuses on locking down the opponent's resources and preventing them from executing their game plan effectively. By utilizing lands as the primary control elements, it aims to disrupt the opponent's mana base, slow down their plays, and eventually win through a powerful land combo like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage. It also has tools to recur key cards like Life from the Loam and effectively utilize artifacts like Sphere of Resistance to control the pace of the game. Overall, the deck aims for a methodical and resource-denial approach to victory.

This Goblins deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. The key to this deck is utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Muxus, Goblin Grandee to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. With cards like Conspicuous Snoop and Goblin Matron for card advantage and tutoring, the deck can maintain momentum and keep the pressure on. The inclusion of cards like Sling-Gang Lieutenant and Food Chain give the deck additional ways to close out the game quickly. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive gameplay and ensure consistent card draws.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan by using disruptive creatures such as Archon of Emeria and Anointed Peacekeeper. The deck aims to control the game through cards like Chalice of the Void and Solitude while also maintaining tempo and aggression through cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Seasoned Dungeoneer. The mana acceleration provided by Lotus Petal and Chrome Mox allows for explosive plays, and the land base of City of Traitors, Ancient Tomb, and Cavern of Souls enables consistent mana production for the deck's threats.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Knight of the Reliquary and Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes, alongside disruptive spells like Punishing Fire and Swords to Plowshares, to quickly establish board control and pressure the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Wrenn and Realmbreaker and Endurance for added utility and resilience against opposing strategies. By utilizing powerful cards from various Legacy sets, the deck aims to efficiently close out games through a combination of efficient threats and disruptive elements.

The deck focuses on the synergy between Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's entire deck. It also includes various cards to support this combo, such as Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer to tutor for the pieces needed. Additionally, the deck includes disruption spells like Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast to control the opponent's game plan. The main goal is to assemble the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo as quickly as possible while disrupting the opponent's strategy to achieve a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using a mix of removal, counterspells, and disruptive creatures. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategies and slow down their game plan while gradually building up its own board presence. It utilizes powerful creatures like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to generate value and control the board. The deck also includes various tutor effects like Natural Order and Green Sun's Zenith to efficiently find the necessary pieces for its game plan. Overall, it focuses on resource management and board control to outlast the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost threats and disruption spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. By combining efficient creatures like Tarmogoyf and Delver of Secrets with powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Stifle, the deck aims to apply constant pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Murktide Regent provide additional value and flexibility, allowing the deck to adapt to various matchups and strategies. By leveraging its speed and versatility, this deck aims to control the board and secure a swift victory.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly assemble the Cephalid Breakfast combo, which involves using Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill the library, then using Dread Return to bring back Thassa's Oracle and win the game on the spot. The deck includes various cards to protect the combo, such as Force of Will and Daze, while also including disruptive spells like Cabal Therapy. Urza's Saga is included to search for key combo pieces, while Teferi, Time Raveler helps to protect against opposing interaction.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by utilizing powerful prison effects like Trinisphere, Chalice of the Void, and Blood Moon. By locking down the opponent's mana base and preventing them from casting spells efficiently, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm them with aggressive creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and Fury. The inclusion of Dragon synergies with cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Laelia, the Blade Reforged adds further power and consistency to the deck's aggressive game plan. Overall, this deck seeks to establish control early and maintain pressure to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with powerful abilities to disrupt opponents while applying pressure on the board. The cards are chosen to maximize efficiency and synergy, with a mix of removal, threats, and utility spells. By combining the toolbox nature of Green Sun's Zenith with the versatility of cards like Knight of the Reliquary and Endurance, the deck aims to control the game's pace and set the tempo in its favor. The land base is carefully crafted to support the deck's strategy and provide consistent mana sources for its powerful spells.

The main concept of this deck is to use cards such as Goblin Welder, Painter's Servant, and Grindstone to assemble a combo that mills the opponent's entire deck. By utilizing cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Karn, the Great Creator, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition. The inclusion of red removal spells and disruptive creatures like Goblin Engineer and Chaos Defiler adds versatility and control to the deck's strategy. With strong mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb, this combo-focused deck aims to quickly and efficiently take control of the game.

The strategy of this Legacy 1 vs 1 Combo - Painter deck revolves around using cards like Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder to manipulate the board, while pairing Painter's Servant with Grindstone to mill the opponent's deck. With the help of cards like Fury and Goblin Welder, the deck is designed to control the game and disrupt the opponent's plans. By combining powerful combos and versatile cards like Pyroblast and Lotus Petal, this deck aims to quickly and efficiently set up its win condition and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to react.

The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to utilize a combination of counterspells and removal spells to control the opponent's board and disrupt their game plan. The deck also focuses on card advantage and library manipulation with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to help ensure consistent draws and set up advantageous plays. Additionally, the inclusion of Narset, Parter of Veils and The Wandering Emperor further enhances card advantage and can lock down the opponent's resources. The deck also incorporates a small creature package with Comet, Stellar Pup to provide additional threats and win conditions.

This deck focuses on using a combination of efficient removal spells, counter magic, and powerful planeswalkers to control the game and outvalue the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage and incremental value through cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Sylvan Library. It also utilizes cards like Prismatic Ending and Swords to Plowshares to deal with threats efficiently, while cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes provide additional card advantage and disruption. The mana base is designed to support the deck's multi-colored spells and synergy with cards like Mystic Sanctuary and Wasteland.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful spells and efficient creatures. With a wide range of color options, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's plans while building up its own board presence. The inclusion of the companion Yorion allows for additional value from flickering permanents. The deck also has a strong toolbox element, utilizing cards like Green Sun's Zenith to search for specific creatures to answer different threats. Overall, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through precise decision-making and resource management.

The deck focuses on generating card advantage and tempo by utilizing powerful artifacts like Urza's Bauble, Mishra's Bauble, and Chalice of the Void. It aims to quickly deploy threats such as Thought Monitor, Emry, Lurker of the Loch, and Sai, Master Thopterist to pressure the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Hullbreacher to control the game. Urza's Saga is a key land that can tutor for important artifacts, while Otawara, Soaring City provides additional mana acceleration. The combination of artifact synergy and efficient threats makes this deck a formidable aggro strategy.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the Cephalid Breakfast combo using Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill the library, putting Narcomoebas into play which can be sacrificed to Dread Return Thassa's Oracle for a win. The deck also utilizes control elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo, while including a Stoneforge Mystic package and Urza's Saga for additional value and flexibility. Teferi, Time Raveler helps to protect the combo from disruption, while Orim's Chant provides additional protection when needed.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. The Death & Taxes archetype aims to use cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth to slow down the opponent's spells, while using cards like Skyclave Apparition and Solitude to remove threats. The deck also utilizes Aether Vial to cheat creatures into play and protect them with Mother of Runes. Overall, the strategy involves controlling the game through efficient disruption and proactive threats.

The main concept of this deck is to establish early board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan through taxing effects like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria. By deploying efficient threats and using disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Karn, the Great Creator, this deck aims to apply pressure and control the game tempo. The inclusion of fast mana sources like Chrome Mox and Lotus Petal allows for quick deployment of threats, while resilient threats like Solitude provide additional versatility in combat situations. Ultimately, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive elements, leading to a powerful and proactive game plan.

The primary focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of land destruction and resource denial, while also utilizing powerful land-based synergies to generate advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Wasteland, while also gaining incremental advantages with cards like Life from the Loam and Urza's Saga. The deck also incorporates a strong toolbox element with cards like Crop Rotation and Expedition Map, allowing it to adapt to various situations and strategies. The ultimate goal is to establish a dominant board presence and outvalue the opponent over time.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay by utilizing powerful creatures like Knight of the Reliquary and Elvish Reclaimer to quickly ramp and search for key lands like Dark Depths. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Swords to Plowshares and Crop Rotation to control the board. With the ability to generate mana quickly and efficiently, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its speed and versatility. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Prismatic Ending and Endurance provide answers to a wide range of threats, making the deck adaptable to different matchups.

The deck focuses on assembling the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's library. It includes cards like Goblin Welder and Engineer to control the game and find combo pieces. The deck also has disruptive elements like Red Elemental Blast and Pyroblast to protect the combo and deal with opponent's threats. Additionally, it has mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The deck revolves around assembling the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's library. It utilizes powerful artifact creatures like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Thought Monitor to help set up and protect the combo. Urza, Lord High Artificer provides additional mana acceleration and card advantage. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Pithing Needle to control the game. Overall, the goal is to quickly and efficiently execute the combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty, Atraxa, Grand Unifier, Griselbrand, and Grief, and then bring them back onto the battlefield using cards like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Exhume. The deck utilizes cards like Faithless Looting, Thoughtseize, and Unmask to filter through the deck and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures early in the game, putting them on the back foot and securing a quick victory.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, then bringing them back onto the battlefield for little to no cost using cards like Exhume, Reanimate, and Animate Dead. Grief and Thoughtseize help disrupt opponent's strategies, while Faithless Looting and Unmask provide card selection and hand disruption. Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual allow for explosive starts, while the mana base of Marsh Flats, Verdant Catacombs, Swamp, and Badlands ensure consistent mana production. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures early in the game, sealing victory through sheer force and speed.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly cheat out powerful and expensive creatures, such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand, by using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. The deck also includes ways to protect these creatures, such as Force of Will and Daze, while also providing card selection and manipulation with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Preordain. The deck's mana base consists of lands that provide fast and efficient mana, such as City of Traitors, Ancient Tomb, and Lotus Petal, allowing for fast and explosive plays.

The main concept of this Legacy UR Tempo deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan using cheap counterspells and removal. By playing efficient threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent alongside powerful disruption like Force of Will and Daze, the deck aims to control the board and win the game quickly. The inclusion of cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder helps ensure card advantage and smooth draws, while the mana base is optimized for consistent early-game plays and Wasteland provides additional disruption.
